name: assetpanda/resource-search
title: AP Resource Search
description: Instant search for the Resource Center and Press Room: results appear under the field while the visitor types (no submit, no reload), from a compact JSON index fetched the first time the field is focused, hovered or touched. Typo-tolerant prefix matching, highlighted matches, arrow-key navigation, a no-results state. Enter and 'View all results' open the full results page; when it is the current listing's own (same scope) and the page has a resource-cards listing, the results change in place with the filter animation instead of a reload. Without JavaScript the field submits to fallback_url as ?q=. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
